steps.en: Officer ticks notices in the search or upload result list
steps.id: Officer mencentang notice di daftar hasil search atau upload

steps.en: Officer chooses Apply Revival and presses Select
steps.id: Officer memilih Apply Revival lalu menekan Select

steps.en: Selected notices are checked and opened on the revival page
steps.id: Notice terpilih dicek lalu dibuka di halaman revival

steps.en: Officer can remove a notice from the chosen list
steps.id: Officer bisa mengeluarkan notice dari daftar pilihan
